PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?cap ?name
WHERE {
  ?org sdk:hasProcessCapability ?cap .
  ?cap rdfs:label ?name .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?name)), "machining"))
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?materialCapability ?label
WHERE {
  ?org sdk:hasMaterialCapability ?materialCapability .
  ?materialCapability rdfs:label ?label .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?label)), "steel"))
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?state ?stateLabel (SUM(?numInt) AS ?totalEmployees)
WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?num ;
       sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  OPTIONAL { ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel . }
  BIND(REPLACE(STR(?num), "[^0-9]", "") AS ?numDigits)
  FILTER(STRLEN(?numDigits) > 0)
  BIND(xsd:integer(?numDigits) AS ?numInt)
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY ?stateLabel

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

ASK {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?stateLabel)), "texas"))
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?manufacturer ?label ?latitude
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?label . }
  ?manufacturer sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:hasSpatialCoordinates ?coords .
  ?coords sdk:hasLatitudeValue ?latitude .
  FILTER(xsd:float(?latitude) > 45.0)
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?manufacturer ?longitude
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:hasSpatialCoordinates ?coords .
  ?coords sdk:hasLongitudeValue ?longitude .
  FILTER(xsd:float(?longitude) < "100.0"^^xsd:float)
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?state ?stateLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?org) AS ?manufacturerCount)
WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state a sdk:State .
  OPTIONAL { ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel . }
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?manufacturerCount)
LIMIT 1

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?manufacturer ?label ?latitude
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?label }
  ?site sdk:hasSpatialCoordinates ?coords .
  ?coords sdk:hasLatitudeValue ?latitude .
}
ORDER BY DESC(xsd:float(?latitude))
LIMIT 1

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel ?state ?stateLabel
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel ;
                sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?stateLabel)), "california"))
}
ORDER BY ?manufacturerLabel

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?state ?stateLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?org) AS ?manufacturerCount)
WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  OPTIONAL { ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel . }
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?manufacturerCount)
LIMIT 1

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?stateName (COUNT(DISTINCT ?m) AS ?manufacturerCount)
WHERE {
  ?m a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
     sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateName .
  FILTER(REGEX(STR(?stateName), "Texas|New York|Florida", "i"))
}
GROUP BY ?stateName
ORDER BY ?stateName

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?mfg) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  ?mfg a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site ;
       sdk:hasProcessCapability ?cap .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateName .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?stateName)), "arizona")) .
  
  ?cap a ?capClass .
  ?capClass rdfs:subClassOf* ?coatingClass .
  ?coatingClass rdfs:label ?coatingLabel .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?coatingLabel)) = "coating") .
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?manufacturer sdk:hasProcessCapability ?cap .
  ?cap a ?capClass .
  ?capClass rdfs:subClassOf* sdk:HoleMakingCapability .
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel . }
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                sdk:hasProcessCapability ?cap .
  ?cap a ?castingClass .
  VALUES ?castingClass {
    sdk:CastingCapability
    sdk:SandCastingCapability
    sdk:DieCastingCapability
    sdk:GravityCastingCapability
    sdk:PermanentMoldCastingCapability
    sdk:CeramicMoldCastingCapability
    sdk:InvestmentCastingCapability
    sdk:MachiningOfCastingCapability
    sdk:SqueezeCastingCapability
    sdk:HotChamberDieCastingCapability
  }
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel . }
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel ;
                sdk:suppliesToIndustry ?audioIndustry, ?visualIndustry .
  ?audioIndustry rdfs:label ?audioLabel .
  ?visualIndustry rdfs:label ?visualLabel .
  FILTER (regex(str(?audioLabel), "Audio", "i"))
  FILTER (regex(str(?visualLabel), "Visual", "i"))
}
ORDER BY ?manufacturerLabel

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?manufacturer ?label
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?label . }
  ?manufacturer sdk:hasMaterialCapability ?capSteel .
  ?capSteel a sdk:SteelProcessingCapability .
  ?manufacturer sdk:hasMaterialCapability ?capBronze .
  ?capBronze a sdk:BronzeProcessingCapability .
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?org ?orgLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?cap) AS ?totalCapabilities)
WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  OPTIONAL { ?org rdfs:label ?orgLabel . }
  ?org (sdk:hasProcessCapability|sdk:hasMaterialCapability) ?cap .
}
GROUP BY ?org ?orgLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?totalCapabilities)
LIMIT 1

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>

SELECT ?naicsCode (COUNT(DISTINCT ?m) AS ?manufacturerCount)
WHERE {
  ?m a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
     sdk:hasPrimaryNAICSClassifier ?naicsInst .
  ?naicsInst sdk:hasNAICSCodeValue ?naicsCode .
}
GROUP BY ?naicsCode
ORDER BY DESC(?manufacturerCount)
LIMIT 1

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?state ?stateLabel (AVG(?employees) AS ?avgEmployees)
WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?empLit ;
       sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
  FILTER EXISTS {
    ?org sdk:manufactures ?prod .
    ?prod rdfs:label ?prodLabel .
    FILTER(REGEX(STR(?prodLabel), "\\d"))
  }
  BIND(xsd:integer(REPLACE(STR(?empLit), ",", "")) AS ?employees)
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY ?stateLabel

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?org ?orgLabel
WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       rdfs:label ?orgLabel ;
       sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site ;
       sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?num ;
       sdk:hasProcessCapability ?cap .
  ?cap rdfs:label ?capLabel .
  FILTER(REGEX(?capLabel, "ing$", "i"))
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?stateLabel)) = "california")
  BIND(REPLACE(STR(?num), ",", "") AS ?numClean)
  BIND(xsd:integer(?numClean) AS ?numInt)
  FILTER(?numInt >= 20)
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?org ?orgLabel
WHERE {
  ?org sdk:suppliesToIndustry ?indRE .
  ?indRE a sdk:RenewableEnergyIndustry .
  ?org sdk:suppliesToIndustry ?indUtil .
  ?indUtil a sdk:UtilitiesIndustry .
  ?org sdk:hasCertificate ?cert .
  ?cert a sdk:ISO9001 .
  OPTIONAL { ?org rdfs:label ?orgLabel . }
}
